facts.text: The collision-situation ranking is intended for design prioritization, not as a global accident-rate league table.
facts.quote: The ranking is for design prioritization, not a global accident-rate league table.

facts.text: The harm ranking of collision situations follows fatality evidence.
The frequency column for collision situations reports the best available signal from official and agency sources.
facts.quote: the frequency column reports the best available signal from official and agency sources

facts.text: The frequency assessment of collision situations weights fatal cases heavily because property-only exposure data are inadequate.
facts.quote: with fatal cases weighted heavily because property-only exposure data are inadequate.

facts.text: Collision-situation counts from different jurisdictions are not added together in the ranking.
facts.quote: Counts from different jurisdictions are not added together

facts.text: A combined cross-country ranking of collision situations could not be built because agencies use different categories.
facts.quote: a combined cross-country ranking could not be built because agencies use different categories.
